svg.title: Battery adapter, switch, XIAO and motor breadboard wiring
svg.desc: Separate unplugged adapter cable only. Protected pack and original connector stay intact. Adapter positive to switch common; ON throw to j18 and XIAO BAT+. Adapter negative to h2 and XIAO BAT-. XIAO D4 to i8. The front and underside drawings show the same board. PN2222ABU E b7 B b8 C b9; 1k d8-g8; 10k d14-g14; diode band g18 plain g22; motor positive h18 negative h22. Six jumpers as listed. Button D1 to GND. No added external capacitor. Proposed circuit, not physically qualified.

g.text: Detachable adapter cable with soldered ends · existing driver · no added 104
Unplug the adapter from the battery and remove USB before cutting, stripping or soldering.
Keep the protected battery, its wires and its original plug intact. Identify adapter polarity; wire colors alone are insufficient.
Cut/strip only the unplugged adapter’s free ends.
Solder + to S1 common; − to the GND junction.
Functional contacts shown; match package drawing.
To charge: S1 ON; motor inhibited.
USB can still power the board
Front and back below are the SAME XIAO.
Solder to the two BAT pads
E b7 · B b8 · C b9
BAND end g18 · plain end g22
Internal pull-up; usable button still needed.
Remove i8–i18 and all bench-supply leads. Remove the USB version’s 3V3 → j18 wire.
Only wire ends plug into holes. Insulated crossings do not join. Support and insulate every solder joint.
Proposed wiring. Startup/total battery load and driver behavior remain unknown; low-battery and USB motor-inhibit firmware pending.
